_doc: The ONE mapping from every cloudy APK-fleet app (the ids of packages/cloudy-ui/nav/nav.json `apps`, plus the tile-only ids c3-bot and ai-chat) to the real web service behind it (#1326). HAND-WRITTEN intent; the resolved private URLs are GENERATED by scripts/gen-app-links.mjs into packages/cloudy-ui/nav/app-links.json (`--check` is the CI drift guard). kind: container = a web UI declared in cloudy-u-containers, `service` is its build.json name and the PRIVATE url is derived from the declaration (mesh hostname https://<name>.mesh.diegonmarcos.com/ when declared, else the c3-pvt path route https://c3-pvt.diegonmarcos.com/<name>/), never hand-typed, never a public host; `path` is an optional sub-path; `alias_ids` lists the id an app will have after an Android-side rename (the link is emitted under whichever id is a fleet app); `entries_open_app` makes the app's own stack entries (the FinTerm tabs) open their web dashboard pages under this link; `backend` (service, path, label) adds a second PRIVATE link to the webapp's own container (derived the same way); `{id}` in a webapp path is the resolved app id. webapp = a page of our own sites (`path` is root-absolute). external = a third-party URL (`url`). phone-only = not a truly web app: the tile renders grey and opens /cloud-webapps/<app>/about/. Rule used to decide: a container with a web UI wins; else a real implementation in our sites; else phone-only (a Kotlin/Wasm preview page does not count).

links.reason: Mail: our Cloud Webmail (Stalwart JMAP webmail)
Chat: Mattermost
Messenger: Element Web on the Continuwuity Matrix homeserver
Dialer: telephony needs the phone; no web service yet
C3 Bot: Telegram bot (tile-only id, not a fleet app)
AI: Telegram agent bot (tile-only id, not a fleet app)
News: the GDELT news aggregator container
Browser: a phone WebView browser, no web service
Navigation: the maps project (mymaps-navigation) served by cloudy-h-webdesktop
Camera: needs the phone camera
Calc: the web calculator built into cloudy-webapps
Keyboard: an Android IME, phone-only
Writer: text tools over OpenRouter on the phone; no web UI container
Wallet: for now Google Wallet / Pay
Vault: Vaultwarden
Drive: FileBrowser web file manager
Tasks / calendar: Radicale CalDAV server
Contacts: Radicale CardDAV server
Notes: Cloud Notes web
Office: Grist spreadsheets
Gallery: PhotoPrism photos
Media: Spotube playlist syncer (music); photos are PhotoPrism under Gallery
Me: the personal-admin launcher, indexes phone-side apps only
Account: device setup, sign-in and per-device secrets, phone-only
CG-Omniverse: its pages (Galaxy, Game Store, VR Store) are web pages of cloudy-webapps; Galaxy opens the CG Galaxy web app (registry 2.1.1), the stores are planned

Capital-Stack-FinTerminal: the web version of the terminal = a dashboard page per FinTerm entry in this site (FI, EQ, EX, NW, PM), built from the Android app's declared sources and dashboards (scripts/gen-finterm.mjs); data from fin-api over the private mesh first, then the key-free public sources where a browser may read them. The tile and every tab entry open these pages; the FinceptTerminal backend (fin-api container on oci-apps, cloudy-u-containers user-fin_fin-api) is the separate Backend (mesh) link, its private URL derived from the container declaration, never a public host
Hardtech-CAD: its pages (MCAD, BIM, SolidWorks) are web pages of cloudy-webapps; MCAD and BIM open their repo folders, SolidWorks is planned
Hardtech-Sim2Real: its pages (SAP2000, MATLAB, Ansys) are web pages of cloudy-webapps; all planned (greyed)
SI: AI chat over OpenRouter on the phone; no web UI container
Search: AI/RSS search app on the phone; no web UI container
Code: VS Code in the browser (code-server)
KG Store: a browser for fleet APIs on the phone; the KG store is a database with no web UI
Tools: small-LLM text jobs on the phone
MyTerminal: Acode/Termux developer apps, phone-only
Terminal: nix-on-droid terminal, phone-only
Termux terminal, phone-only
C3: the C3 console site (cloudy-c3)
Morpheus: the Dagu workflow scheduler
Watchdog: a transcribed TUI dashboard on the phone
Watchtower: pipeline analytics panel on the phone
C3 Webserver: the phone local web server (Tauri), phone-only
Store: the fleet app store, installs APKs on the phone
Shopping (#1473): an offline deals and listings browser over mock data, no web service behind it
